title: M12 — Break/fix 02: a cert valid for the wrong name
description: config-api is Running, its Certificate is Ready, and the TLS Secret exists — but the mTLS call fails with 'no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name'. The server cert's SANs omit config-api.media.svc.cluster.local, the name the client dials. Read the cert's SANs, put the real dnsNames back, and reload nginx.
